reviews.title: Solid 140mm ARGB fans
reviews.comment: I bought a 3-pack because these 140mm fans are the exact same model used on the large Liquid Freezer III 420mm radiator. Now the top and bottom fans in my case match. PROs: They're daisy-chainable so you don't need a ton of fan and A-RGB headers on your motherboard. The colors are pretty good and they're very quiet at low to mid RPMs. Also I think Arctic might be the only brand offering a 6-year warranty on all their products (most other brands only cover 2-3 years) so I expect them to last. CONs: The connections for chaining them are closer to the far end of the cables, which could make chaining them a little challenging in some situations. If you arrange these adjacently then it would make more sense to connect right by the fan body itself. Some others (e.g. Lian Li)  even snap together directly but these don't. Also they don't make a reverse version, so I had to install these upside down. They don't look as good as they could because now the supports are visible, as well as the 12 LEDs that run along the back inner circumference of each fan. There are no LEDs elsewhere like fancier fans, so it's just the translucent blades that illuminate. Note: Don't over-tighten the screws, or the blades might scrape on the mounting bracket or case housing. That's true for any large fans though if you warp the frame slightly.

reviews.title: Great fans
reviews.comment: Great fans - they are super quiet and look great. Arctic came highly recommended to me so I decided to get some for a new work pc build. No regrets. 3 140mm and 2 120mm. They’re quieter than the noctua fans in my personal pc. Only downside is there isn’t a dedicated rgb software for them.
